 The Milwaukee Bucks travel to Philadelphia to take on the 76ers on Saturday night in an Eastern Conference matchup featuring two teams looking to establish themselves early in the 2026-27 NBA season.

 How to Watch Bucks vs 76ers
 When: Saturday, October 24, 2026
 Time: 7:30 PM ET
 TV Channel: NBA TV, NBC Sports Philadelphia
 Live Stream: Fubo ( try for free )
 Milwaukee enters Saturday’s contest searching for its first victory after opening the season with losses to the Washington Wizards and Chicago Bulls. The Bucks fell 132-125 to Chicago on Friday, leaving them with little time to regroup before facing Philadelphia on the road. Milwaukee will need to tighten up defensively after surrendering at least 125 points in each of its first two games, while finding ways to generate consistent offense against a talented 76ers squad.
 Philadelphia has gotten off to a strong start, winning its first two games against the New York Knicks and Cleveland Cavaliers. The 76ers are coming off a 114-106 victory over Cleveland and will look to keep their momentum going in front of their home crowd. With Tyrese Maxey leading the backcourt and Joel Embiid anchoring the frontcourt, Philadelphia has the star power to make noise in the Eastern Conference, and another victory would give the team an impressive start to the new campaign.
